strings.KHP_NEU_CONTROL: {khp_getnamedef} is controlled by A NEUTRAL PARTY.
strings.KHP_bloodstained_legacy_desc: Even within the SS, Peiper's command is infamous for its refusal to show quarter, as well as regular massacres of both civilians and POWs. Feared and hated by both the Wehrmacht remnants and civilians, Peiper can expect short shrift if his situation turns sour.
strings.KHP_eagles_nest_desc: Situated in the Austrian Alps, Peiper's Kampfgruppe is in a very favorable defensive position. Peiper is an expert commander of armor and infantry alike; the terrain will prove no obstacle to his units should the fight come to them.
